description: Returns the power ranking of a competition from the free Dixon-Coles model offered by Docteur Bet: each team's attack and defence strength relative to the league average (1 = average; a lower defence figure is better), an overall index (attack / defence), and the gap between its strength rank and its actual league position.

lang.description: Language of the summary and notices: "en" or "fr".

name: get_team_strengths
title: Team strengths (power ranking)
